templates.pat: {{1}} is an open-access database of curated, non-redundant transcription factor (TF) binding profiles, stored as position frequency matrices (PFMs), as well as deep learning (DL) models, covering multiple species in six taxonomic groups.
templates.zh: {{1}} 是一个开放获取数据库，收录经人工审编、非冗余的转录因子（TF）结合谱，以位置频率矩阵（PFM）和深度学习（DL）模型形式存储，覆盖六个类群中的多个物种。

templates.pat: This API provides an easy-to-use REST web interface to query/retrieve matrix profile data from the latest version of the JASPAR database. The API comes with a human browsable interface and also a programmatic interface which return the results in eight different formats, including {{1}}, {{2}}, {{3}}, {{4}}, {{5}}, {{6}}, {{7}} and {{8}}.
templates.zh: 本 API 提供易用的 REST Web 接口，用于查询/获取最新版 JASPAR 数据库中的矩阵配置文件数据。API 同时提供供人浏览的界面和编程接口，可按八种不同格式返回结果，包括 {{1}}、{{2}}、{{3}}、{{4}}、{{5}}、{{6}}、{{7}} 和 {{8}}。

templates.pat: A RESTful {{1}} to programmatically access the latest version of the {{2}} database.
templates.zh: {{1}} 用于以编程方式访问最新版本的 {{2}} 数据库。

templates.pat: JASPAR is supported by a growing number of open source software tools and APIs implemented in various programming languages, including Perl, Python/Biopython, R/Bioconductor, and Ruby. In addition, the TFBS enrichment tool was introduced in the 2022 release. The TFBS extraction tool has been described since 2024. In the 2026 release, we introduced a regulatory sequence simulation tool {{1}}. Each of those resources is described in more detail below.
templates.zh: JASPAR 得到越来越多开源软件工具和 API 的支持，涵盖 Perl、Python/Biopython、R/Bioconductor 和 Ruby 等多种编程语言。此外，TFBS 富集工具于 2022 年版本引入，TFBS 提取工具自 2024 年起提供。2026 年版本中，我们引入了调控序列模拟工具 {{1}}。以下对各资源作更详细的介绍。

templates.pat: JASPAR provides genomic TFBS predictions for eight organisms ({{1}}, {{2}}, {{3}}, {{4}}, {{5}}, {{6}}, {{7}}, and {{8}}) with the JASPAR CORE PFMs associated with the corresponding taxon.
templates.zh: JASPAR 为八个物种提供基因组 TFBS 预测（{{1}}、{{2}}、{{3}}、{{4}}、{{5}}、{{6}}、{{7}} 与 {{8}}），使用与相应类群对应的 JASPAR CORE PFM。

templates.pat: DNA sequences were scanned with JASPAR CORE TF-binding profiles for each taxa independently using {{1}}. We selected TFBS predictions with a PWM relative score ≥ 0.8 and a p-value < 0.05.
templates.zh: 使用 {{1}} 分别对每个类群的 DNA 序列进行 JASPAR CORE TF 结合谱扫描。我们选取 PWM 相对得分 ≥ 0.8 且 p 值 < 0.05 的 TFBS 预测。

templates.zh: {{1}} 表示在背景模型所描述频率下观察到某序列的概率。

templates.pat: There are two principal explanations. templates.zh: 主要有两种解释。最可能的一种是我们不了解您的工作：{{1}}另一种可能是该论文未达到审编人员的预期。由于 JASPAR CORE 的全部矩阵都经过人工审编，这在一定程度上是主观判断，我们乐意与您讨论。

templates.pat: However, maybe your motif is already part of the UNVALIDATED collection, where we store motifs without supporting orthogonal literature. In case your motifs of interest are part of the UNVALIDATED collection, please fill in the fields provided at the {{1}} section at each motif page (e.g., a literature support for your motif) so our curation team can have a look and evaluate its further incorporation into the CORE collection.
templates.zh: 不过，您的基序可能已收录于 UNVALIDATED 合集，该合集存放缺乏正交文献支持的基序。如果您的目标基序属于 UNVALIDATED 合集，请在每个基序页面的{{1}}部分填写相应字段（例如为您的基序提供文献支持），以便我们的审编团队查看并评估是否将其进一步纳入 CORE 合集。

templates.pat: {{1}} is a Pythonic interface to JASPAR TF motifs. It utilizes Biopython and SQLite3 to provide a serverless interface to the JASPAR database, enabling queries and access to TF motif profiles across various JASPAR releases. The pyJASPAR package will be updated when future JASPAR releases become available.
templates.zh: {{1}} 是 JASPAR TF 基序的 Python 接口。它利用 Biopython 与 SQLite3 提供对 JASPAR 数据库的无服务器接口，可跨多个 JASPAR 版本查询和访问 TF 基序配置文件。未来 JASPAR 发布新版本时，pyJASPAR 软件包也会随之更新。

templates.pat: {{1}} is a Python package for creating simulated motifs, dimers, background, and complete regulatory sequences. Using user-provided parameters and/or input files, inMOTIFin inserts motif instances into background sequences in a controlled manner.
templates.zh: {{1}} 是一个 Python 软件包，用于生成模拟基序、二聚体、背景序列和完整的调控序列。它依据用户提供的参数和/或输入文件，以可控方式将基序实例插入背景序列。

templates.pat: The {{1}} aligns an input DNA binding motif (PFM matrix, JASPAR string, or IUPAC sequence) against motifs retrieved from the JASPAR database.
templates.zh: {{1}}可将输入的 DNA 结合基序（PFM 矩阵、JASPAR 字符串或 IUPAC 序列）与从 JASPAR 数据库检索到的基序进行比对。

templates.pat: The {{1}} predicts which sets of TFBSs from the CORE collection in the JASPAR database are enriched in a set of given genomic regions. Enrichment computations are performed using the LOLA tool. The tool allows for two types of computations:

templates.pat: The {{1}} allows the extraction of JASPAR TFBSs intersecting with an input set of genomic regions in BED format.
templates.zh: {{1}}可提取与输入的 BED 格式基因组区域集合相交的 JASPAR TFBS。

templates.pat: The Biopython package {{1}} has a subpackage dedicated to JASPAR, which is called {{2}}. It allows the retrieval of profiles from the JASPAR database as well as reading and writing motifs in various flat file formats. To read more about this module, please visit {{3}}.
templates.zh: Biopython 包 {{1}} 有一个专门面向 JASPAR 的子包，名为 {{2}}。它可以从 JASPAR 数据库检索配置文件，并读写多种平面文件格式的基序。欲了解该模块的更多信息，请访问 {{3}}。

templates.pat: A Ruby gem providing basic functionality for parsing, searching, and comparing JASPAR motifs. To learn more about this tool please visit {{1}} and the repository at {{2}}.
